answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, we bind recursive zero-knowledge reputation to sequential delay functions. This computational barrier acts like a gale dispersing a weak ember, neutralizing spoofing attempts. The resulting cryptoeconomic Nash equilibrium stands as solid as marble, proving that the cost of forging concurrent proofs always exceeds any potential double-spend payoff.
